note: THE VARIANTS OF A FAMILY (Lane B, lane-b-variant-split, Nov 17 2026): one entry per family whose variants price apart and share one generation key. A family is a make, its model words, and the years it covers. variants lists each variant MOST SPECIFIC FIRST (a package before the variant it is a package of): a sale takes the first variant whose words its title or details name; a sale that names none is 'unstated', never base. words are case-insensitive regular expressions. package names the variant this one is an option package on (the GTA is a package on the Trans Am). includesPackages (default false): when this variant is asked for, its packages are counted with it; false means a package is its own variant and is set aside when its parent is asked for. vin, when a family has one, reads the variant from the VIN: { pos: 1-based position, years: [first, last], map: { character: variant name } }; no family below has a verified VIN rule yet, so none carries one and the variant comes from the words. To add a family add an entry here; no code changes.
